stats_soon: The statistics page is being built – check back soon.
st_intro: Analytics on shops and products from the grabber data. All figures refer to the data snapshot noted below.
st_fx_note: Foreign currencies converted to EUR (rates: ECB/Frankfurter, fallback for rare currencies; cached in memory up to 6 h).
st_cache_note: Computed live, cached in memory for up to 15 min.
st_error: Statistics data is currently unavailable (source missing or being generated).
sp_reach_title: Most popular species (number of shops listing them)
sp_rarities_count: {n} species are available in only a single shop.
sh_exclusive_title: Exclusive species (shop is the only seller)
pr_basis_note: Basis: entry price per active ant offer (lowest positive price of the active variants), converted to EUR. Depending on the shop, the entry price may refer to a different colony size.
pr_spread_title: Largest price range per species (cheapest to priciest shop, EUR; min. 5 shops)
pr_spread_small_title: Smallest price range per species (most uniform price across shops, EUR; min. 5 shops)
av_hardest_title: Hardest to get (rarely in stock; min. 5 shops)
av_nowhere_line: {n} species are listed in at least 5 shops but currently in stock nowhere – show
dq_intro: How clean are the shops' species names? The bot maps every raw name to the accepted AntCat name (canonical) – fixing typos, resolving synonyms and consolidating spellings.
dq_shop_uncanon_title: Shops with the most offers without canonical
dq_shop_adjusted_title: Shops with the highest adjustment rate (min. 20 offers)
dq_variants_title: Species with the most consolidated spellings
dq_all_resolved: All species names are resolved – currently no unresolved raw names. 🎉
tr_unavailable: No price history available (price_history.db missing or empty).
tr_price_title: Price trend over time (median entry price, EUR)
tr_price_note: Basis: lowest price per offer from the price history (incl. offers deactivated since), carried forward between changes; EUR at current rates (no historical rates available). Offers that disappeared entirely from the shop data are missing.
tr_drops_title: Largest price drops in the selected period (top 10)
tr_increases_title: Largest price increases in the selected period (top 10)
tr_avail_title: Availability over time (in-stock rate per month)
tr_avail_empty: No stock history yet – the grabber records it from now on; the curve will appear here over time.
exp_sec_overview: Overview of the whole market: headline figures, country distribution and availability of all ant offers.
exp_sec_species: How supply and diversity spread across genera and species – incl. reach and rarities.
exp_sec_shops: Comparison of shops by assortment size, diversity and exclusivity.
exp_sec_prices: Price level and spread of all offers (entry prices in EUR).
exp_sec_availability: Share of offers currently in stock – broken down by genus, country and shop.
exp_sec_quality: Quality of species names: coverage by accepted names, corrections and unresolved raw names.
exp_sec_trends: Development over time: prices, price changes and availability.
exp_countries: Number of shops per country (top 10, rest bundled). Shows where the scene is concentrated.
exp_stock: Share of active ant offers currently in stock vs. out of stock. Deactivated (no longer listed) offers are not counted in any figure.
exp_genera: Which genera provide the most offers (area = number of offers; top 10 + other).
exp_reach: Species listed in the most different shops – a measure of popularity/spread.
exp_longtail: Distribution: how many species are offered in how many shops. Shows: a few everywhere, many rare.
exp_rarities: Species available in only a single shop (active offers only). The list shows all of them with their shop and can be filtered by species or shop.
exp_shop_offers: Shops with the most ant offers (assortment size).
exp_shop_breadth: Shops with the most distinct species (breadth – not just many variants of one species).
exp_shop_exclusive: For how many species a shop is the only seller.
exp_shop_scatter: Each point a shop: x = distinct species (breadth), y = offers (depth).
exp_price_hist: Frequency distribution of entry prices; “5–<10” means 5 € up to below 10 €. Very high prices (from the 99th percentile) are bundled in the last bar.
exp_price_genus: Typical price (median) per top genus – what each genus usually costs.
exp_price_spread: Each shop counts with its cheapest offer of the species; shown is the range between the cheapest and priciest shop. Note: entry prices may refer to different colony sizes (e.g. queen only vs. colony with workers).
exp_av_genus: In-stock rate per top genus: share of offers currently in stock.
exp_av_country: In-stock rate per country (only countries with at least 20 offers).
exp_av_shop_best: Shops with the highest in-stock rate (min. 20 offers).
exp_av_shop_worst: Shops with the lowest in-stock rate (min. 20 offers) – often without active stock upkeep.
exp_av_hardest: Species listed in at least 5 shops and in stock somewhere, but rarely available (bar = in-stock rate, above 0 %; number of shops in brackets). Species currently in stock nowhere are in the expandable list above.
exp_dq_shop_uncanon: Shops with the most offers whose name could not be resolved to an accepted name.
exp_dq_shop_adjusted: Shops with the highest rate of adjusted names (typo/synonym corrected; min. 20 offers). Bar = adjustment rate; number of adjusted offers in brackets.
exp_price_spread_small: Species with the smallest real price range across shops (each shop's cheapest offer; bar = min to max; identical prices, Δ 0, excluded). Entry prices may refer to different colony sizes.
exp_dq_variants: Species with the most different raw spellings consolidated into one name.
exp_tr_price: Median of the lowest price per offer and month; carried forward between changes, EUR at current rates. Different basis than the current figures above (there: lowest price of active variants).
exp_tr_changes: Number of price changes per month, split into decreases and increases (zero/placeholder prices ignored).
exp_tr_drops: Largest price drops in the selected period, strongest entry per species (basis: each offer's latest change), with shop. Implausible jumps (drop of 90 % or more) are hidden.
exp_tr_increases: Largest price increases in the selected period, strongest entry per species (basis: each offer's latest change), with shop. Implausible jumps (above +500 %) are hidden.
exp_tr_avail: In-stock rate per month over time (from the new stock history).

contact_intro: 📨 Note: Your message is delivered to the operator as a Discord direct message (not by e-mail) and answered promptly.
contact_privacy: By sending, your message is transmitted to the operator via Discord for delivery. Details:
flash_contact_sent: Thanks! Your message has been delivered.
flash_contact_fail: Message could not be delivered – please try via e-mail.
flash_contact_toomany: Too many messages – please try again later.
flash_contact_empty: Please fill in name, e-mail and message.

board_intro: Public ideas & reported bugs. Anyone may submit anonymously and upvote – new submissions appear only after review.
sec_jobs_note: discord.ext.tasks loops in the bot process
sec_cron_note: 2 cron jobs · status based on freshness of generated files
submit_anon: Anonymous is fine. Your submission is reviewed first and then appears publicly.
submit_terms: By submitting you accept the board terms of use: factual ideas/bugs about the bot, no personal/sensitive data and no offensive or unlawful content. The operator may reject, edit or delete entries.
admin_legend_edit: Use ✏️ to edit title/description & for comments.
csv_help:
Columns (any order/case, separator , or ; ): type,title,body,status,component,priority,version,created_at,source
Required: title. Valid status: open, planned, in_progress, done, rejected, duplicate, pending (default: done). Valid type: bug, feature, idea.
After import a message “N imported, M skipped” appears; skip details are in the bot log.
inc_intro: Recorded are “not OK” phases (yellow/red). When a phase ends, it is automatically noted when the check was OK again.
flash_too_many: Too many submissions – please try again later.
flash_submitted: Thanks! Your submission will be reviewed and then appear publicly.
map_intro: Find roughly where other ant keepers of the community are – voluntary, only coarse location. Join via /map_join on Discord.
map_u18_notice: Privacy: joining is voluntary (opt-in), shows only a coarse, randomly offset position (no exact place/address) and is removed automatically when you leave the server. Remove anytime with /map_remove. Anyone stating they are UNDER 18 is NOT shown individually on the map/list, only counted anonymously.
map_cal_hint: The button opens your device's calendar app (e.g. Apple Calendar, Outlook, Thunderbird). For Google Calendar, copy the link and paste it under “Other calendars → From URL”. New and changed events arrive automatically.
map_attribution: Boundaries: {bounds} · postcodes/places: © GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) · map: Leaflet
map_disabled: The keeper map is currently disabled (MAP_ENABLED).
map_oauth_unconfigured: Discord login is not configured yet (BOARD_OAUTH_*).
map_list_empty: No entries yet. Add yourself on Discord with /map_join.
map_st_privacy: 🔒 Privacy: without login, numbers below {min} are shown as “< {min}” so nobody can be traced. Under-18 entries only count towards totals.
map_st_growth_note: current entries by month joined, last 12 months
map_st_login: More statistics (tags, nearby, contact, attendance) after login.
map_st_near_note: straight-line distance between the shifted pins, excluding you
map_st_near_none: Join with /map_join to see how many keepers are near you.
map_st_myev_none: You haven't marked any event as “I am going” yet.
map_st_empty_none: Every region has at least one keeper 🎉
map_join_entry: Get on the map: type /map_join in Discord
map_join_rsvp: After logging in, click “I am going” on events
map_partner_empty: No partners yet. The bot project is private and ad-free.
map_partner_contact: Interested in a partnership? Here's how
yr_page_intro: The community's ant year {y} in numbers. Happy New Year {n}!
yr_page_note: Community part: totals only, no individuals. Values below 3 are shown as “< 3”. Your personal review is also available on Discord via /rueckblick.
yr_me_login: Log in with Discord to see your personal year in review (visible only to you).
yr_wait_h: The year in review is hibernating
yr_wait_text: The review of {y} opens on {d} and stays open until the end of January. Until then: some ant facts.
chat_hello: Hi! Ask me about species, offers, prices, shops or discount codes. Answers may contain mistakes.
chat_placeholder: Your question (Enter to send, Shift+Enter new line)
chat_note: Messages are sent to Anthropic (Claude) to generate answers. There is a daily limit. History is deleted after {h} hours. Please do not enter personal data.
chat_error: Sorry, that did not work. Please try again later.
chat_rate: Slow down: too many messages in a short time. Please try again shortly.
chat_login: Please log in with Discord (AAM server members only).
yr_inat_new: species found for the first time in the community
dir_card_hint: Download the species card as PNG, e.g. for Discord
inat_page_intro: All ant species that members observed on iNaturalist and posted in the iNat channel. Only own observations with a linked account count.
inat_page_empty: No finds yet. Post your iNaturalist links in the iNat channel and link your account with /inat_verknuepfen.
inat_page_note: Totals only, no names. Genera only count if no more precise species within them was found. Identifications according to iNaturalist, updated daily.
dir_delivery_exp: Calendar days from order to arrival as described in the ratings. Median: {m} days.
login_discord_note: The admin area is only reachable via “Log in with Discord”, for the owner and listed admins.
login_no_admin: This Discord account has no admin rights on the board.
login_oauth_missing: Log in with Discord is not configured on this server.
exp_sec_usage: How the bot is used: totals only, no names. Only commands available to everyone are counted, no admin commands. Values below 3 are shown as “< 3”.
us_none: Usage statistics are being calculated for the first time. Check back in an hour.
us_calls_title: Commands and active users per month
us_content_title: New ratings and discount codes per month
us_note: Months with fewer than 3 active users are shown without a user data point. Figures are updated daily.
dir_art_index_intro: {n} species are currently offered by tracked shops. Click a species for prices, price trend and shops.
dir_trend_exp: Month-end value of the cheapest offer across all shops listing the species today. Other currencies converted to EUR.
dir_art_note: Data as of {d}. Prices without shipping. Availability alerts: /notification in Discord.
dir_art_missing: This species is currently not offered by any tracked shop. Use /notification in Discord to get notified when it becomes available.
dir_art_unknown: No species is known by this name.
dir_shops_intro: All tracked shops with community rating and assortment. Click a shop for details.
dir_level_exp: Median deviation from the median price per species, only species listed at 3 or more shops. Minus = cheaper.
dir_warn_note: These notes come from community reports and are not a factual finding by the operator. Affected shops are welcome to get in touch:
dir_recent_note: Only visible to logged-in members of the AAM server.
dir_login_more: More details, rating history and community reports are available after login, for members of the AAM server only.
dir_shop_note: Ratings from the community rating table, assortment and prices from shop data (updated hourly).
konto_login_text: See and change everything the bot has stored about you: notifications, price tracking, settings, quiet hours, events, DM history and your data. AAM server members only.
konto_login_off: Log in with Discord is not configured on this server.
konto_intro: Only you can see this page. All changes apply immediately, also in Discord.
konto_ai_text: You have used {p} % of your daily limit today.
konto_ai_global: the shared daily limit for everyone is {p} % used
konto_quiet_now: Your quiet hours are active right now ({s}:00 to {e}:00). Messages will follow afterwards.
konto_notif_intro: The bot sends you a DM as soon as a species is available in the chosen countries. Paused notifications stay saved but are not checked.
konto_swiss: only shops that ship to Switzerland
konto_notif_hint: Same rules as /notification in Discord. If the species is already available, you will get a DM right away.
konto_err_species_format: A species needs genus and species name, e.g. Messor barbarus. For a whole genus choose “Genus”.
konto_err_regions: Please choose at least one country that has shops.
konto_err_unknown: “{term}” is not listed in any shop. With “create anyway” the notification is saved anyway.
konto_tracked_none: You are not tracking any products yet.
konto_target_hint: Target price in the shop currency. “additional”: DM on every change and an extra one at the target. “target only”: only the DM when reached. Empty the field and save = target off.
konto_ps_more: {n} more results, please search more precisely.
konto_ps_none: There are currently no products for “{q}”.
konto_track_variants: Pick single variants (sizes) with /track_price in Discord.
konto_watches_intro: New products and price changes of a species or genus in all shops.
konto_digest: Weekly digest by DM (Mondays: price drops, new species and shops)
konto_rsvp: Reminder at 6 pm the day before for events I joined
konto_quiet_hint: During quiet hours (German time) I hold back availability, price, species and offer DMs and send them afterwards. The weekly digest (Monday 9 am) and the event reminder (6 pm) come at their fixed time.
konto_bl_intro: These shops do not appear in your notifications.
konto_kw_intro: If an offer in the offers channel matches a keyword, you get a DM. At most {n} keywords.
konto_events_none: You have not joined any upcoming event. You can find events on the
konto_ics_intro: A private calendar link with only the events you joined. Anyone with the link can see these events. “Create new link” makes the old one invalid.
konto_map_change: Change place and visibility with /map_join in Discord.
konto_map_none: You are not on the keeper map. Join with /map_join in Discord.
konto_inat_step2: Put this code into your bio (“About me”) and save:
konto_inat_step3: Then check here. The code is valid for one hour.
konto_inat_intro: Link your iNaturalist account so your observations from the iNat channel count in the statistics.
konto_reviews_intro: Ratings you wrote in the rating channel. Only you can see this link to you; in the rating table you stay anonymous.
konto_history_intro: What the bot recently sent you by DM (short preview only, {d} days, at most {n} entries).
konto_export_intro: Everything the bot stored for your Discord ID as a JSON file.
konto_sessions_intro: Ends your board login on all devices, including this one.
konto_delete_intro: Deleting is final. You can delete single areas or everything.
konto_delete_all_sure: Yes, I really want to delete all my data.
konto_delete_note: Not deletable here: the command log (moderation, deleted automatically after {d} days), today’s AI daily limit (abuse protection) and submitted events (public, but your ID is removed). Ratings and discount codes in the channels are Discord messages; delete those in Discord.
konto_area_notifications_d: all notifications and already reported products
konto_area_prices_d: price tracking, target prices and species watches
konto_area_settings_d: language, blacklist, digest, keywords, quiet hours, event reminder, intros, calendar link
konto_area_achievements_d: unlocked achievements and the activity log for them
konto_area_ai_d: conversation histories, chosen model, cost ledger
konto_area_reviews_d: which ratings are yours (for the year review); the ratings themselves stay
konto_area_history_d: the stored previews of your DMs
konto_confirm_inat: Really unlink? Your posts will no longer count.
konto_confirm_all: Really delete ALL your data for good?
konto_m_notif_added: Notification created. If the species is already available, a DM follows shortly.
konto_m_bad_price: Please enter a valid price, e.g. 24.90.
konto_m_watch_added: Watch created. From now on I will report new products and price changes.
konto_m_kw_added: {n} keywords added. Still open offers from the last days follow by DM.
konto_m_ics_new: New calendar link created. An old link no longer works.
konto_m_inat_code: Code created. Put it into your iNat bio and then check.
konto_m_logout: You are now logged out on all devices.
intro_skip: Click or press Esc to skip
konto_intros: Short intros for occasions when opening the board (holidays, anniversaries, new achievements)

intro_easter_s: The ants already brought you an egg.

intro_spring_s: Colonies are becoming active again. Bring them out of winter rest slowly.
intro_join_s: Today is your anniversary on the AAM server. Great to have you here!
intro_join_s1: Today is your anniversary on the AAM server. Great to have you here!

konto_unlock_s: I understand that deleting here is final and causes data loss, and I really want to delete something here. Only applies until the page is reloaded.
konto_m_locked: Deleting is locked. Please confirm “Unlock deleting” at the top.
fnd_note: Prices converted to euros, cheapest matching offer. “Ships to Switzerland”: Swiss shops and shops on the Switzerland delivery list (/ch_delivery). The bot does not know other shipping countries.
fnd_more: {n} more results, please narrow the filters.
star_hint: Create a species watch: DM on new offers and price changes in all shops
star_login: Log in with Discord to watch species
hp_intro: All bot commands with examples, the features here on the board and frequent questions.
hp_cmds_note: Commands only work in the bot channel. Type / and the name, Discord shows you the options.
hp_b_finder_d: Filter the species page by genus, price, shop country and stock. Use 🔔 to create a notification right away.
hp_b_star_d: The star on a species page creates a species watch right away: DM on new offers and price changes in all shops. Also for the whole genus.
hp_b_card_d: Every species page has a shareable image card with prices, trend and season; in Discord via the button below /art.
hp_b_shops_d: Shop pages with ratings, assortment, price level, delivery time and discount codes. Logged in you see more rating details.
hp_b_konto_d: Everything the bot stored about you: notifications, prices, settings, quiet hours, events, DM history, download and deletion. Deleting must first be unlocked at the top of the page.
hp_b_map_d: Voluntary, coarse entries of keepers (via /map_join) and events like fairs and meetups. With “I’m going” you get a reminder the day before.
hp_b_yearreview_d: From November to January: the community year in numbers, logged in also your personal review. Older years stay available.
hp_b_inat_d: All species the community found on iNaturalist and posted in the iNat channel. To be counted: link your account with /inat_verknuepfen.
hp_b_stats_d: Market, prices, availability and trends from the shop data, plus bot usage. Totals only, no names.
hp_b_chat_d: Bottom right when logged in: questions about species, offers and shops. There is a daily limit; you can see your usage in My account.
hp_b_intros_d: On holidays, anniversaries and new achievements a short intro plays when you open the board, at most one per day. Click or Esc skips it; it can be turned off in My account.
hp_b_board_d: On the start page you can report bugs and suggest ideas, even without an account. At the top you can see whether the bot is running.
hp_f_nodm_q: I don’t get any DMs from the bot.
hp_f_nodm_a: In Discord, check the server’s privacy settings to see whether direct messages from server members are allowed. You can test it with /testnotification. If you set quiet hours in My account, messages arrive afterwards.
hp_f_channel_a: All commands only work in the server’s bot channel so the other channels stay clear.
hp_f_data_q: How do I see or delete my data?
hp_f_data_a: In My account (/konto) you see everything, can download it as a file and delete it per area or completely. Details are in the privacy policy.
hp_f_ampel_q: What do 🟢 🟡 🔴 next to prices mean?
hp_f_ampel_a: The price light compares an offer’s current price with its own prices over the last 12 months: 🟢 rather cheap, 🟡 normal, 🔴 rather expensive. It only appears once there are at least 90 days of price history.
hp_f_source_q: Where do the shop and price data come from?
hp_f_source_a: From the AntCheck API, updated hourly. Ratings come from the community’s rating channel.
hp_f_review_q: How do I rate a shop?
hp_f_review_a: With /bewerten you fill in the template in two forms and get the finished text. Post it in the rating channel; the bot adds it anonymously to the rating table.
hp_f_quiet_q: Can I have peace from DMs at night?
hp_f_quiet_a: Yes, set quiet hours in My account under settings. Availability, price and offer DMs then arrive afterwards.
hp_f_intro_q: How do I turn off the intros?
hp_f_intro_a: In My account under settings. Without login each intro only appears once anyway.
konto_left_h: You are no longer on the AAM server
konto_left_text: My account and the member areas are for members only. You can rejoin or delete the data the bot still has stored about you.
konto_left_join_text: After rejoining you can use everything again. Notifications and settings are still there; your map entry and event sign-ups were deleted when you left.
konto_left_del_text: Deletes everything the bot stored for your Discord ID: notifications, prices, settings, iNat, achievements, AI chat, rating assignment and DM history. You will be logged out afterwards.
konto_m_left_deleted: Your data has been deleted and you are logged out.
sw_intro: Built from the reports in the Discord channel #schwarmflug-meldungen since {since}. Every report counts, evaluation is automatic.
sw_now_none: Nothing reported in the last 48 hours. Last report: {d}.
sw_members_only: Exact locations and links to the reports are only visible to logged-in members of the AAM server.
sw_season_exp: Reports per calendar week, averaged over all years with reports. Per species when a genus is selected.
sw_taxa_exp: From 3 reports. Period = middle 80 % of reports, time and temperature = middle half.
sw_note: Read automatically from free text, occasional errors are possible. Flights indoors or in a tank are not shown on the map. Reporter names are not shown.
sw_art_genus_only: No report for this species yet, but {n} for the genus {g}.
hp_b_swarm_d: Map, season curve and profiles from all reports in the nuptial flight channel. Members see exact locations. In My account you can set up a flight alert for your region.
konto_sw_intro: I send you a DM as soon as someone reports a flight of the chosen species or genus in your region in the nuptial flight channel. Your quiet hours apply here too.
konto_m_sw_bad: Species, genus or region not recognised (at most 20 alerts).
konto_area_swarm_d: Delete alerts. Your evaluated reports remain only as anonymous statistics without location.
sw_season_open: The {y} nuptial flight season has started!
sw_tl_hint: Time-lapse: week by week through the season (all years of the period combined)
sw_id_h: What is flying here right now?
sw_id_exp: Only reports identified to species, from 5 per species. Counts reports 7 days before and after the day (all years), the chosen region three times, then how well time (±2 h) and temperature (±3 °C) fit.
sw_id_intro: Found a queen and not sure which species? Enter day, time and region. The list shows what the community reported most often there at that time.
sw_id_note: Only a likelihood from the reports, not an identification. Only a look under the microscope or an identification key is certain.
sw_id_none: There are too few reports for this time yet.
sw_wx_exp: Weather at flight time at the location (rounded to about 10 km), added from Open-Meteo. Range = middle half of reports. Without a time the typical flight time of the species is used.
sw_wx_intro: Weather has been added for {n} reports with a location. This shows the weather during flights, not whether it was the same on days without flights.
sw_wx_rain: Rain (1 mm or more) in 24 h before
sw_cmp_exp: The curve shows which share of a year’s reports falls on each week. This makes years comparable even though the community has grown and reports more today than in 2019.
sw_cmp_tx_earlier: {x} flew {d} days earlier on average in {a} than in {b}.
sw_cmp_tx_later: {x} flew {d} days later on average in {a} than in {b}.
sw_cmp_tx_same: {x} flew at about the same time in {a} and {b}.
sw_cmp_all_earlier: Overall, flights in {a} were {d} days earlier on average than in {b}.
sw_cmp_all_later: Overall, flights in {a} were {d} days later on average than in {b}.
sw_cmp_all_same: Overall, flights in {a} and {b} happened at about the same time.
sw_cmp_few: A statement needs at least {m} reports in both years ({a}: {na}, {b}: {nb}).
sw_cmp_note: “On average” = median flight day. Up to 2 days difference count as the same. The number in brackets next to the temperature says how many reports it is based on (reported or filled in).
sw_years_exp: Middle flight day per year (median), for species with at least 3 reports in at least 3 years. A higher point means later flights that year.
sw_temp_est: estimated from weather data (Open-Meteo), not reported
konto_sw_start_d: Once a year, as soon as the season has started (first confirmed report from March).
intro_swarmstart_t: The nuptial flight season has started!
fc_exp: Weather forecast from Open-Meteo (March to October, at 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 h) at about 400 grid points (35 km) and the reporting hotspots. Learned per genus or species from your reports since 2019 and the weather on those days, otherwise a rule from the profiles. Only shown where the species has been reported before.
fc_members_cells: Logged-in members see the chances per grid point.
fc_nothing: I see no good chances for this day.
fc_resting: The forecast rests until March. Until then I learn from the reports and the weather of past years.
fc_quality_exp: Checked on the last two years, which were held back during learning. “Hits” = how much more often there was a report within 15 km on days with a very good chance than on average. “Discrimination” (AUC): 0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect.
fc_q_rules: {n} more species use a rule (too few flight days to learn, at most level “good”).
fc_q_pending: {n} point-years of weather still to learn.
konto_fc_h: Forecast DM the evening before (for your alerts)
sw_abroad_exp: Reports from countries outside Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Liechtenstein. They are listed here but not used for the map, profiles, season curve or forecast.
sw_abroad_hint: Abroad, not used in the analysis
sw_unclear_intro: Reports without country and region. They are not used in the analysis. With a region role or a clear place in the message (editing is enough) they are picked up automatically.
sw_home_hint: Region estimated from the person’s other reports (no place given)
sw_home_note: {n} reports without a place count with an estimated home region (regions only, never as a point).
sw_raw_hint: reported as: {raw} (name checked against the species list)
sw_prog_eta: Learning data done in about {d} days, around {date} (currently about {n} point-years a day).
sw_prog_eta_today: Learning data should be done today.
sw_lrn_h: Map: where learning data is in
sw_lrn_exp: Each dot is a weather point of the forecast. The greener, the more years since 2019 are loaded. Places with many reports and recent years come first.
sw_lrn_guest: Places with many reports are only shown to logged-in members.
sw_lrn_fine: of them with the finer source, the rest will be refined
sw_wr_exp: Middle value (median) of all reports of the region. Temperature from the report or filled in, rain = share of flights with at least 1 mm in the 24 hours before. Regions with fewer than 3 reports stay grey.
sw_cl_exp: From the weather of all years since 2019: on how many days of this week was there good flight weather for the chosen species at this place, i.e. conditions like on real flight days (forecast level good or very good)?
sw_cl_note: ▶ plays the season week by week. This is an average over all years, not a forecast for this year.
sw_cl_wait: Appears once the forecast has finished learning. See the data collection below for progress.
sw_wc_intro: All reports with an exact place. {n} more only have a region and get no weather (a state is too large).
sw_ev_intro: Per learning point, all days since 2019: how often would the model have said “very good”, and how often was there really a report within 15 km on such days? Compared with the average of all days at the same point.
sw_ev_good: matches well (reported at least twice as often)
sw_ev_never_rep: “very good”, but never reported (probably few reporters)
sw_ev_t_rep: days with a report in total
sw_prog_pause: paused due to the limit, continues in about {m} min
sw_prog_budget: Weather service today: {u} of {m} requests used (the free access allows under 10,000 per day, so collecting takes a few weeks).
sw_fix_saved: Correction saved. It applies until the message is edited in Discord.
sw_names_intro: Checked against the species list (AntCat): synonyms are certain, typos only guessed. Guessed corrections are listed first: ✓ confirms, ✗ keeps the genus only. Unknown names count as “genus sp.” until the AI or you clarify them.
sw_names_ai: AI, confirmed by the species list
sw_names_set_bad: ❌ The species list does not know this name. Please check genus and species.
sw_names_all_q: Confirm all {n} guessed corrections as correct?
sw_prog_blocked: weather service limit reached for today, continues after midnight
